camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise UpdateTaskFlowNotification --region cn-hangzhou --DagNotificationSuccess true --DagNotificationSla true --DagId 15000 --DagNotificationFail true
description_en: Calls the UpdateTaskFlowNotification operation to update the notification settings of a task flow
description_zh: 调用UpdateTaskFlowNotification接口，更新任务流通知设置
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise update-task-flow-notification --dag-id 15000 --dag-notification-fail true --dag-notification-success true --dag-notification-sla true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTaskFlowNotification

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The task flow ID, which is the unique identifier of the task flow. You can obtain this parameter by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，任务流的唯一标识。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable notifications when the task flow fails. This feature is disabled by default. Manually enable it
parameters.help_zh: 任务流运行失败通知开关。默认关闭，请手动开启
parameters.name: dag_notification_fail

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable notifications when the task flow succeeds. This feature is disabled by default. Manually enable it
parameters.help_zh: 任务流运行成功通知开关。默认关闭，请手动开启
parameters.name: dag_notification_success

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the global SLA notification switch for the task flow. This feature is disabled by default. Manually enable it
parameters.help_zh: 任务流SLA通知全局开关。默认关闭，请手动开启
parameters.name: dag_notification_sla
